question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as order_count,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
top_3_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        order_count,
        avg_payment,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_payment DESC) as rn
    FROM customer_stats
),
purchase_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        MIN(date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) as earliest_purchase,
        MAX(date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) as latest_purchase
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    t.customer_id,
    t.order_count,
    t.avg_payment,
    CASE 
        WHEN (date(p.latest_purchase) - date(p.earliest_purchase)) / 7 < 1.0 
        THEN 1.0 
        ELSE ((date(p.latest_purchase) - date(p.earliest_purchase)) / 7)::DOUBLE
    END as lifespan_weeks
FROM top_3_customers t
JOIN purchase_dates p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE t.rn <= 3
ORDER BY t.avg_payment DESC
